Dev — quick answers inline: 
- Model artifacts: we have two shards today (custom Llama-2 base + small task-tuned head) and use an internal script to reassemble at load time. We'll upload the reassembly script to the Drive folder you linked.
- KV/cache: session keys are persisted to Redis with a 24-hour TTL; we have sticky routing at the LB layer for active sessions.
- Traffic shape: median ~45 tokens, 95th ~280 tokens; peak QPS tends to show 20% bursts around promotions (we can provide a sample CSV).

Wed Jun 2 at 14:00 PDT still works for us. We will have Sylvia (me) + one infra engineer (Ken Liu) and our procurement lead on the call. I uploaded the reassembly script to the Drive folder and added a short readme.
